reason: I've never heard of Nora Furnish and I can't tell from photos whether a paper pendant is well made or whether the LED and wiring are any good. I'd save it to a Pinterest board and keep looking, not spend $360 a fixture on a store I don't know.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and paying return shipping on a big fragile pendant if it arrives looking cheap makes that risk mine.
would_change_my_mind: Free return shipping or a cheap sample, plus real customer photos and reviews, UL/ETL listing shown on the product page, and a verified review from another designer or host.
